label: AI-OPERATED B-ONLY CONTROL WITH UNCHANGED SHORTEST LENGTH AND DIFFERENT SEARCH WORK
forecastScope: Unchanged FIFO examined nodes relative to the prompt-provided 15; no independent count calculation, rationale or closer-goal/route-length forecast inferred.

geometricShortestPathCheck.note: A route from x=0 to x=6 must cross column 5. That column is blocked at y=0 and y=1, so a route must reach y=2 and return to y=0. A valid ten-move path meets this lower bound.

priorTests.reason: Core, parser, paired evaluator and integration-test source unchanged; new geometry/paths and the controlled comparison were checked directly.

interpretation: The unchanged FIFO prediction is not borne out in this case: work increases by one node while shortest length stays ten. Closer-goal work decreases by three nodes on the same B-only change. This distinguishes route length from search work and refutes a universal decrease of examined nodes under wall removal for this FIFO implementation. Both searches succeed; this is not an algorithm failure, measured runtime/energy claim or general effect-size estimate.
provenance: Student supplied a scoped pre-run expectation for the AI-proposed B control. AI transcribed, operated the committed evaluator, validated the geometry/paths and authored the initial analysis. One synthetic layout pair; validation is not additional independent trials. Post-result student interpretation is pending.
